subject: general
question: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated Phase 1 of Modi Shaikshanik Sankul, an educational complex in ______ in October 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ahmedabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated Phase 1 of Modi Shaikshanik Sankul, an educational complex in Ahmedabad, **Gujarat in October 2022**.
 
• The project is a part of the government's efforts to provide** quality education to all sections of society**.
 
• The complex will provide facilities for holistic development of **students, including hostel, classrooms, laboratories, and sports facilities**.
 
• It will also have a library, an **auditorium**, and a **cafeteria**.
 
• The complex is expected to benefit over **1,000 students**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
